title: Forecast revenue from Dataverse
subtitle: Load revenue data, train linear regression and save predictions back to Dataverse.

steps.title: Retrieve revenue records
steps.evidence: The Dataverse SDK for Python queries selected table columns and loads the returned records into a Pandas DataFrame for analysis.

steps.title: Train the regression model
steps.evidence: The example trains Scikit-Learn LinearRegression on month and revenue columns, then predicts revenue for months 6, 7 and 8.

steps.title: Write forecast results
steps.evidence: The Python client creates records in a revenue prediction table, storing each future month and its predicted revenue for downstream experiences.
